title: Zara's Swiss research dream
caption: CHF 2,450 every month for research or a PhD in Switzerland 🇨🇭 The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are open to 183 countries, but deadlines depend on YOUR country (many close 27 Nov). Comment LINK 👇 #swissgovernment #scholarship #phd #research #studyabroad

scenes.backdrop: sunny campus café with big windows, plants and wooden tables

beats.text: I just finished my master's and I want a PhD abroad. But who pays a PhD student?
beats.say: I just finished my master's and I want a P.H.D. abroad. But who pays a P.H.D. student?
The Swiss government might. The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships.
Two thousand four hundred and fifty Swiss francs. Every month?

beats.text: For research or a PhD at a Swiss university. Twelve months, and it can be renewed up to thirty six.
beats.say: For research or a P.H.D. at a Swiss university. Twelve months, and it can be renewed up to thirty six.

scenes.backdrop: modern university research lab with microscopes, screens and soft light

beats.say: You need your master's done by the end of July twenty twenty seven, and you must be born after December thirty first, nineteen ninety one.
Wait. A letter from a Swiss professor? I don't know any Swiss professor!
That's the key step. Find a professor whose research matches yours, email them, and ask if they will support your project.
It depends on your country. Many close on November twenty seventh. Check your country on the official list today.
Country list opened. Professor email being written. Switzerland, let's talk!
